hooks.text: There is a planet where the atmosphere is made of iron gas.
One scorching alien world has clouds, but they never drop water.
At 2,400 degrees Celsius, an alien atmosphere vaporizes pure iron.

title: The Alien World Where It Rains Molten Iron
description: Astronomers discovered that extreme temperatures on WASP-76b vaporize iron on its dayside, triggering winds that cool into molten metal rain.

beats.text: There is a planet where the atmosphere is made of iron gas.
beats.visual: artist concept of ultra-hot Jupiter WASP-76b orbiting host star, ESO, 2020

beats.text: 640 light-years away in Pisces, gas giant WASP-76b orbits its star in 1.8 days.
beats.visual: star chart of the constellation Pisces, IAU, 2011

beats.text: Blasted by radiation, this world has inflated to nearly twice the diameter of Jupiter.
beats.visual: artist concept comparing inflated hot Jupiter size with Jupiter, NASA, 2019
queries: Hot Jupiter exoplanet size comparison NASA

beats.text: One side is trapped in eternal daylight, soaring past 2,400 degrees Celsius.
beats.visual: artist concept of glowing dayside of tidally locked exoplanet, ESO, 2020

beats.text: This inferno is hot enough to rip molecules apart and vaporize solid iron.
beats.visual: artist impression of glowing metallic atmosphere on WASP-76b dayside, ESO, 2020

beats.text: Ferocious winds sweep that metallic gas to the nightside, where it cools to 1,500 degrees.
beats.visual: artist impression of atmospheric winds crossing terminator on exoplanet, ESO, 2020

beats.text: Researchers using the Very Large Telescope detected iron at dusk but nothing at dawn.
beats.visual: photograph of the Very Large Telescope at Paranal Observatory at twilight, ESO, 2019
queries: Very Large Telescope Paranal dusk ESO

beats.text: They concluded that as the gas cools, it condenses into torrential rains of liquid iron.
beats.visual: artist concept of molten iron rain falling on nightside of WASP-76b, ESO, 2020
queries: exoplanet nightside rain artist impression ESO

beats.text: These metallic winds confirmed a cycle that never ends on this world:
beats.visual: artist's concept of the WASP-76 planetary system, ESO, 2020
